text: Execute the calibrated autonomy benchmark v3 matched comparison
description: Execute the frozen 2026-08-01.v3 protocol exactly once: four unchanged multi-file fixtures under graph_grounded and stateless, gpt-5.6-sol, workspace-write-no-network, 170000 tokens and 90000 ms per run, alternating graph-first-even order, zero retries, and preservation of all errors. Do not reuse pilot records or run a new smoke because the adapter and fixtures are already verified and the excluded pilots served calibration. Analyze only through analyzeAutonomyBenchmarkV3 and record capability_positive, efficiency_positive, null, negative, or invalid without reinterpretation. Do not touch the development server.

reflections.context: Executed the frozen calibrated v3 manifest: eight new confirmatory gpt-5.6-sol runs, unchanged v2 fixtures/scoring, 170000 tokens, 90000 ms, alternating order, zero retries, and no pilot reuse.
reflections.outcome: All 8/8 runs were admissible, independently verified, and had zero human interventions and policy violations. V3 returned valid null. Graph-grounded: completion 1, recovery 0.75, mean 39570.25 ms, 93802.75 tokens, 4.5 tools. Stateless: completion 1, recovery 0.75, mean 35059 ms, 93522 tokens, 4.5 tools. Qualifying efficiency metrics: 0.
reflections.effectiveness: Calibration eliminated the structural budget invalidity, yielding a complete comparison. The prospective efficiency hypothesis did not replicate: graph grounding used 0.30% more tokens, equal tools, and 12.87% more wall time. The tasks still had a completion ceiling.
reflections.lesson: The v1 resource reduction was not robust on new richer fixtures. Additional synthetic micro-benchmark iterations have diminishing evidential value; future evaluation should use representative long-horizon work with outcomes that do not saturate.
reflections.pattern: Replicate exploratory signals prospectively and accept null results before investing in optimization.

status.comment: Calibrated v3 confirmatory run complete: valid null, 8/8 safe completions, zero qualifying efficiency improvements. Awaiting user acceptance.

valueRationale: This is the first adequately calibrated prospective test of the preregistered resource-efficiency signal on richer tasks.
